title: The Temple, part three: the hero fact row, event date stamps and the member's first name

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const bad=[];const h=r('components/sites/house-home.tsx'),c=r('components/sites/temple-css.ts'),m=r('app/api/sites/[slug]/membership/route.ts');if(!h.includes('templeStamp')||!h.includes('heroFacts'))bad.push('house-home no longer builds the stamp and the hero facts');if(/createClient|cookies\(/.test(h))bad.push('house-home reads a session');if(!c.includes('.hs-stamp')||!c.includes('.hs-hero-facts'))bad.push('temple skin lost the stamp or the fact row');if(!m.includes('firstName'))bad.push('membership route lost firstName');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1286: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"

detail: Follows LIVE-1285 and LIVE-1284. On a Temple site the house Home's offerings section draws the Space's next three public events (the one anonymous reader, lib/sites/menswork-data.ts loadMensworkLive, so a site render never reads the visitor's session) with the design's clay arch date stamp and the 'Sun Oct 25 · 5–7 PM' line (lib/sites/temple-events.ts, read from the stored wall clock, never a zone), and the Features facts move up into the hero as the design's fact row. The membership route (app/api/sites/[slug]/membership) now also answers the reader's own first name, and the Temple account pill leads with it. Still open: the Your house account page, the RSVP island, the week-strip arches.
